title: Peirastic
summary: PEIRAS'TIC, adjective [Gr. to strain, to attempt.] Attempting; making trial. 1. Treating of or representing trials or attempts; as the peirastic dialogues of Plato.

inlines.v: PEIRAS'TIC, adjective [Gr. to strain, to attempt.] Attempting; making trial. 1. Treating of or representing trials or attempts; as the peirastic dialogues of Plato.
